Helicopters are evacuating people and dropping food. - AP: CM puts deaths at 7 and the preliminary loss at ₹4,600 crore; crop and road damage estimates have risen sharply. - Centre: the Union Home Minister spoke to the CMs of AP, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Puducherry; Inter-Ministerial Central Teams are assessing damage from 30 October. - Network: 33 agencies met in the IAC coordination meeting 29 Oct); IAG Odisha shared its SitRep; first agency entry received in the URS form. - New system: a depression may form on 31 October and head towards the AP coast.

reports.summary: **SITUATION UPDATE** **A. Situation Overview (28–29 October 2026)** Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Arnab crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Narasapuram (West Godavari). The landfall process began at about 01:30 IST on 28 October, with sustained winds of 125–135 km/h gusting to 150 km/h. IMD forecast a storm surge of 1.5–2.5 m over low-lying Kakinada and Yanam. North coastal AP and south Odisha were hit hardest by rain. The system is moving NNW inland and weakening.
